quests.title: A Traveler's Toolkit
quests.description: Fallen branches and soft fibers lie all over the meadow. A little crafting goes a long way.

steps.text: Braid twine from fiber (I opens crafting)
Make a plank at the workbench near the cottage

hints: Fiber and branches lie in the grass all over the meadow. The workbench is beside the cottage.
